final_topology.title: Hybrid Cloud for Finance
final_topology.description: Set up a hybrid cloud environment with Azure Red Hat OpenShift and secure connection to on-premises datacenter.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Azure VNet with a Red Hat OpenShift cluster, a central firewall, and a private connection to the on-premises datacenter.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' and an 'Asset Inventory Database', which suggests that an asset inventory is being maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple data flow links (e.g., 'nl4', 'nl5', 'nl6', 'nl7') and peering links (e.g., 'zl3', 'zl4', 'zl5', 'zl6') that document data flows between different zones and nodes.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z4) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z5), with specific data flow links (e.g., 'nl_new7', 'nl_new8', 'nl_new9', 'nl_new10', 'nl_new11', 'nl_new12') that indicate segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3), which are explicitly labeled as firewalls and are connected to various zones and nodes.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n8) and multiple DNS resolution links (e.g., 'nl4', 'nl5', 'nl_new16') that indicate the configuration of trusted DNS servers.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and a link (nl10) labeled 'MFA for remote access', indicating that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n9) and multiple DNS filtering links (e.g., 'nl6', 'nl7', 'nl_new17') that indicate the use of DNS filtering services.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and multiple web proxy links (e.g., 'nl8', 'nl9') that suggest the enforcement of network-based URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., 'Management Zone', 'Sensitive Data Zone', 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone') and links (e.g., 'zl3', 'zl4', 'zl5', 'zl6') that indicate a secure network architecture with segmentation and least privilege.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2), an 'On-Premises Firewall' (n3), and a 'Management Zone' (z3) with nodes like 'Azure Monitor' (n6) and 'Azure PaaS Services' (n7), suggesting secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and multiple links (e.g., 'nl10', 'nl14', 'nl_new14') that indicate centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Private connection' (zl1) labeled as a VPN and an 'Identity Server' (n11) with links (e.g., 'nl10', 'nl14') that suggest remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n15) in the 'Management Zone' (z3) and links (e.g., 'nl14', 'nl_new4', 'nl_new13') that indicate dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n12) and links (e.g., 'nl11') that indicate the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Central Firewall' (n2) and multiple peering links (e.g., 'zl3', 'zl4', 'zl5', 'zl6') that suggest traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n11) and links (e.g., 'nl10', 'nl14') that suggest the management of access control for remote assets.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n16) and a link (nl15) labeled 'Flow logs to SIEM', indicating the collection of network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n13) and links (e.g., 'nl12') that indicate the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n14) and links (e.g., 'nl13') that suggest the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n10) and links (e.g., 'nl8', 'nl9') that suggest the performance of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z4) and 'Non-Sensitive Data Zone' (z5), which can be interpreted as production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n_new2) and links (e.g., 'nl_new2', 'nl_new6') that suggest the performance of periodic external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.evidence: [{"zone_id": "z7", "name": "Security Management", "zone_type": "management"}]
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of a detailed and up-to-date inventory of all enterprise assets, including their network addresses, hardware addresses, machine names, asset owners, and departments.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a detailed asset inventory.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system or provide documentation of the asset inventory.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing Zone (z6) with peering links (zl7, zl8) to the Azure VNet and On-Premises Datacenter, which suggests the possibility of external penetration testing, but there is no explicit evidence of periodic testing.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service or provide documentation of periodic external penetration tests.
